newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks stall in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks stall in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks were stalled in early Monday morning trade due to a lack of direction, brokers said.
They added the market was in the process of building up strength to break out of the box in which it is currently stuck.
As of 0014 GMT, the key Nikkei 225 was 5.59 points, or 0.03 percent, higher at 20,935.32. Its December futures were 30 points lower at 20,940.
"Corporate interim earnings announcements are continuing and investors are choosing shares of firms which show signs of doing well," said one broker.
